text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week approaches me during
training with
a serious look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer? Uh...
This is really hard for
me to
say, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've, uh, gained some weight recently...
I'm really
embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yay, that sounds great! Thank you!
choice_data_list: Then let's do some extra training...!
Then let's do some extra training...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'll train hard and be back to running
form in no
time! We're in this together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week focuses on her running for
a while
and successfully reaches her
target weight.
